name: fade_music_channel_volume

stack.evidence: func_001E9C70 reads three stack values in channel, target volume, duration order, converts the one-based channel to zero-based, scales the target percentage into the sound volume range, multiplies duration by eight, calls func_0011C5F0, and decrements Script stackTop by three

notes: func_0011C5F0 forwards to the music-channel volume transition routine func_001EE618. The 24 JP calls use channels 1 or 2, target volume zero, and duration 40; calls occur at cinematic boundaries and commonly precede command 415 stop_background_music or command 252 reload_background_music.
